codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: What are the working Race for Eggs codes?
items.answer: One code is working as of September 19, 2026: RELEASE, which grants a free Lizard pet that earns cash from your first session. New codes tend to arrive with the Saturday updates — see the codes page for the current list.

items.question: How do I get pets in Race for Eggs?
items.answer: Win races to earn eggs, then hatch them into pets. Winning is the only repeatable egg source — carrying an egg slows you down, so a course becomes farmable once you can win it while holding the egg.

items.question: What does rebirth do in Race for Eggs?
items.answer: Rebirth trades current progress for a permanent cash multiplier — creator footage shows multipliers past 512× the base rate at high rebirth counts. The rule of thumb: rebirth when rebuilding will be faster than continuing the grind.

items.question: Is Race for Eggs free to play?
items.answer: Yes — the core loop is fully playable free. The shop sells acceleration (potions, packs) and Roblox Plus accounts earn +10% cash, but racing and eggs are earned, not bought.
